posts.en:
dsh-composer-expand is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ea58868dfaed39b56334.html
